literature_notes: CLRN1 (Clarin-1) is a 4-TM protein with topology: ICL(1-7) – TM1(8-29) – ECL1(30-98) – TM2(99-121) – ICL2(122-134) – TM3(135-155) – ECL2(156-188) – TM4(189-209) – ICL3(210-232). Both the N-terminus (residues 1-7) and C-terminus (residues 210-232) are INTRACELLULAR. Every ledger entry (L1–L12) describes HA, Venus, or YFP tags placed at one of these two intracellular termini: L1/L2/L4–L12 all use a C-terminal HA or fluorescent-protein fusion (insert_after_residue=232, intracellular), and L3 places an HA tag immediately after the ATG start codon (insert_after_residue=1, also intracellular). No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (30-98) or ECL2 (156-188), the only extracellular spans. Because the ledger is the sole permitted evidence source and it contains zero extracellular-loop insertions, zero surface tag sites qualify. The two intracellular tag positions are recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA (and Venus/YFP in L8/L10) tag placed after the last residue (Y232); the C-terminus lies in the intracellular span 210-232 and is not accessible from the extracellular face.
N-terminal HA tag knocked in immediately after the ATG start codon (Met1) in mouse Clrn1; the N-terminus lies in the intracellular span 1-7 and is not accessible from the extracellular face.
